Hi Alice —

Appreciate the questions — answers inline below and I’ve attached a marked-up copy of the questionnaire where we filled standard responses to your procurement fields.

- Encryption: Yes — all customer data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest by default. We offer customer-managed KMS for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted we support CMK via our KMS integration for Enterprise customers (note: key material remains in customer KMS).

- Subprocessor access: The standard hosted offering restricts human access to logs and prompt content; access is gated with RBAC and requires an approved ticket for debugging. Subprocessors that may process content are: AWS (compute), Sentry (error monitoring — only anonymized traces unless a customer supports verbose logs), Datadog (metrics), and our analytics partner (redacted). See redwood_subprocessors_v2.xlsx for role-level access.

- SOC 2: The current Type II audit is scoped to our hosted platform and includes controls around data encryption, change management, and access controls. AWS us-east-1 is included in the scope for hosted production. Expected completion: target audit report available by 2027-03-15.

- HIPAA / BAA: We can sign BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted we evaluate on a case-by-case basis and require additional contractual and operational controls. I asked Rishi to weigh in below.

Action items we completed and next steps:
1) Attached: vendor_questionnaire_acme_filled.xlsx (marked answers).
2) Attached: redwood_subprocessors_v2.xlsx (columns: subprocessor, purpose, region, data_access_level).
3) Proposed follow-up window: Tue 11/30 9am PST — happy to confirm?

Link to shared doc with subprocessor detail: https://docs.redwood.ai/s/abc123/redwood-subprocessors-v2

Thanks — Marissa
